coherency group
A set of implicit read accesses and implicit write accesses for which the RTE cares for data coherency. Please note that in the context of this specification the definition of coherency includes that • read data values of different VariableDataPrototypes have to be from the same age, except the values are changed by implicit write accesses belonging to the coherency group • written data values of different VariableDataPrototypes are communicated to readers NOT belonging to the coherency group after the last implicit write access belonging to the coherency group.
